items.definition: To buy something, used especially in official writing, notices and business emails.
examples: Customers who purchase two items will receive a discount.
Please keep your receipt as proof of purchase.

items.definition: To get something, especially by asking for it or making an effort.
examples: You must obtain permission before entering the laboratory.
Further information can be obtained from the main office.

items.definition: To need something, or to make it necessary by rule or law.
examples: This position requires at least two years of experience.
All visitors are required to sign in at reception.

items.definition: To begin, used mainly in official announcements, contracts and ceremonies.
examples: The ceremony will commence at noon.
Building work is due to commence in March.

items.definition: As much as is needed for a particular purpose.
examples: There is sufficient evidence to support the claim.
Ten minutes should be sufficient to complete the form.

items.definition: To have your home in a particular place, used in official forms and documents.
examples: Applicants must reside in the city for at least a year.
The family currently resides in Edinburgh.

items.definition: To bring something to an end, especially a contract, an agreement or a service.
examples: The landlord may terminate the agreement with one month's notice.
Your account will be terminated if you break the rules.

items.definition: To ask for information about something, especially in writing or in a polite, official way.
examples: I am writing to enquire about the evening courses.
Several customers have enquired whether the shop will open on Sundays.

items.definition: To try to do something, usually something difficult.
examples: Do not attempt to repair the machine yourself.
She attempted to open the window, but it was stuck.

items.definition: Added to what already exists; more than what you have or expected.
examples: An additional charge applies for luggage over twenty kilos.
We would be grateful for any additional information you can provide.
